questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं—अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A): सहायता अनुदान की अगली किस्त जारी करने के लिए उपयोगिता प्रमाणपत्र (UC) जमा करना अनिवार्य है। कारण (R): UC से स्वीकृति देने वाले प्राधिकारी को आश्वासन मिलता है कि सार्वजनिक धन का दुरुपयोग या अन्यत्र उपयोग नहीं हुआ और उसे निर्धारित उद्देश्य पर खर्च किया गया।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता
A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है
questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): The submission of a Utilization Certificate (UC) is mandatory for the release of subsequent installments of Grants-in-Aid. Reason (R): The UC provides assurance to the sanctioning authority that public money has not been diverted or misappropriated and was spent on the intended objectives.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. Submitting a Utilization Certificate is mandatory before subsequent grant installments can be released. The UC provides legal assurance that public money was utilized strictly for authorized objectives without diversion or misappropriation. This necessity to verify proper utilization directly explains why submitting a UC is a mandatory prerequisite for releasing further grant funds
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अगली किस्त जारी करने से पहले UC अनुदान के उचित उपयोग का प्रमाण देता है और सरकारी धन के दुरुपयोग की आशंका कम करता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_english: Expenditure control in school administration primarily refers to:
options_english: Restricting all institutional operational expenditures to exactly 50% of the overall sanctioned annual budget
Discharging staff members systematically to reduce the recurring financial burden on the state government
Delaying vendor bill payments indefinitely to maintain an artificially high bank balance throughout the year
Ensuring funds are spent for approved purposes within allocated limits
questions.explanation_english: Ensuring funds are spent for approved purposes within allocated limits. Expenditure control in institutional administration refers to maintaining continuous oversight over financial disbursements. It ensures that public funds are utilized strictly for approved administrative purposes, in compliance with financial rules, and strictly within sanctioned budget limits. It prevents over-spending, misapplication of funds, and unauthorized commitments while maintaining operational efficiency

questions.question_english: Under government financial rules, the Principal of a school is officially designated as the Head of Office (HOO) and commonly functions as the:
options_english: Chief Accounts Officer (CAO)
Financial Advisor (FA)
Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO)
Pay and Accounts Officer (PAO)
questions.explanation_english: Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO). questions.question_english: Select the statement that is incorrect regarding Performance Budgeting:
options_english: It effectively bridges the gap between financial allocations made and the physical targets achieved by the institution
It facilitates a comprehensive understanding of the strategic direction and educational progress in which the institution is moving
It relies on an incremental approach, adding a fixed percentage to the previous budget
It strictly requires a robust, systematic framework for recording, monitoring, and reporting physical progress continuously
questions.explanation_english: It relies on an incremental approach, adding a fixed percentage to the previous budget. Performance Budgeting directly connects financial inputs to physical targets and operational achievements, requiring continuous monitoring of progress. The statement that it relies on a simple incremental approach adding fixed percentages to past spending is incorrect. Incremental adjustments belong to traditional line-item budgeting, whereas performance budgeting demands analytical evaluation of objectives, output metrics, and target achievements

key_facts: Answer key: (C)

questions.question_english: Under typical financial rules, can funds be re- appropriated from one Major Head to another Major Head of account?
options_english: Yes, by the Head of School acting as the DDO at any time during the fiscal year
Yes, but only after obtaining formal written approval from the Zonal Education Officer
No, re-appropriation between Major Heads requires legislative approval
Yes, but such re-appropriation is strictly permitted only during the month of March
questions.explanation_english: No, re-appropriation between Major Heads requires legislative approval. Major Heads represent broad functional functions of government expenditure. Re- appropriation between different Major Heads is strictly prohibited at the executive or Head of School level. Any movement of funds across Major Heads alters the legislative grant structure and therefore requires formal legislative approval through supplementary demands presented to the assembly

questions.question_english: Which statement below correctly defines one of the “Standards of Financial Propriety” expected from a Principal?

Allowances such as traveling allowance can be used as a source of extra profit for staff.
Government funds can be utilized for the benefit of a particular religious community.

questions.explanation_english: The expenditure should not be prima facie more than the occasion demands.. questions.question_english: A Principal receives special funds specifically for “Capital Outlay on Education”. Which of these actions would be a violation of the purpose of this fund?
options_english: Disbursing pending Dearness Allowance arrears to staff
Purchasing heavy-duty technical equipment for the advanced science and computer laboratories
Constructing a new multi-purpose sports pavilion and outdoor athletic stadium facility for students
Acquiring a fleet of new school buses for student transportation across the district
questions.explanation_english: Disbursing pending Dearness Allowance arrears to staff. Funds allocated under “Capital Outlay on Education” are legally restricted to capital asset creation, such as constructing facilities, buying vehicles, or procuring heavy technical lab equipment. Disbursing Dearness Allowance arrears represents a recurring personnel cost under Revenue Expenditure. Using capital funds for salary arrears violates the mandatory purpose of capital allocations

questions.question_english: A government audit team visits a school and observes that the Principal consistently holds large amounts of unspent budget allocations until March 31st, causing the funds to lapse without formal surrender. What is the likely audit perspective on this?

अभिकथन (A): नए निर्मित कक्षा-कक्ष के लिए मानक फर्नीचर खरीदना पूंजीगत व्यय माना जाता है। कारण (R): पूंजीगत व्यय का उद्देश्य ऐसी परिसंपत्तियाँ बनाना है जो मौजूदा वित्तीय वर्ष से आगे भी संस्था के काम आएँ।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है
A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता

questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): The purchase of standard furniture for a newly constructed classroom is classified as capital expenditure. Reason (R): Capital expenditure is intended to create assets that provide long-term utility to the institution beyond the current financial year.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. Procuring durable classroom furniture is classified as capital expenditure because it adds tangible physical assets to the institution. Capital expenditure is specifically intended to acquire assets that deliver operational utility across multiple financial years. Thus, the long- term utility provided by durable assets directly explains why classroom furniture procurement is categorized under capital expenditure
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। नए कक्षा-कक्ष के लिए फर्नीचर खरीदने से दीर्घकालिक उपयोग वाली परिसंपत्ति बनती है, इसलिए इसे पूंजीगत व्यय माना जाता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_english: In which of the following scenarios is re- appropriation of funds generally NOT permitted?
options_english: To meet expenditure on an entirely new service or scheme not contemplated in the budget
From a plan scheme that has been delayed to another plan scheme requiring funds
From the ‘Office Expenses’ minor head to the ‘Supplies and Materials’ minor head within the same major head

questions.explanation_english: To meet expenditure on an entirely new service or scheme not contemplated in the budget. Re-appropriation is strictly prohibited when attempting to fund an entirely “New Service” or new scheme not originally contemplated or approved in the annual budget estimates. Funding new services requires formal legislative approval through supplementary demands for grants rather than simple executive re-appropriation between existing operational budget heads

The relationship between the funds allocated and the results achieved
Justifying the existence of the institution from scratch every year

questions.question_english: In the context of school finance, Capital Expenditure refers to:
options_english: Funds spent routinely on the day-to-day operational maintenance and upkeep of the school building infrastructure
Regular monthly salary and allowance payments made to permanent and contractual academic teaching staff members
Spending to acquire tangible assets of a permanent nature

questions.explanation_english: Spending to acquire tangible assets of a permanent nature.
